items.implementation: Hydrate authorized creator full name and linked Activity title; preserve private media boundaries.
Host/cohost can open invite share sheet, send invitation to authorized chat and redeem through authorized RPC.
Invalidate in-flight mint, recipient resolution, send, clipboard and navigation callbacks when initiating account changes.
Check clipboard return value and provide selectable detail fallback when copying fails.
Use authorized deduplicated own metric; do not expose private metric for another account.
Admin-only receipt read policy and version/time/loading/error/retry/no-receipt UI.
Replace eight native confirmation paths with cancellable in-app controls that invalidate across navigation/account changes.
Accessible liker sheet with profile links, pagination and safe loading/error/empty handling.

Use existing deterministic guard for registration labels/options/answers, entry names, Activity feedback, public Partner name/description and Community rules/tags. Preserve unrelated legacy edits; no image classifier claim.
Bounded Admin/Master-only retained authentication IP read viewer, actor-scoped cancelable query, honest loading/error/empty states; no geography, risk scoring or fabricated data.
HTTPS getUserMedia capture to JPEG with explicit preview/retake/cancel and track/lifecycle cleanup, preserving native camera behavior. No web gallery fallback.

Disabled consent-bound hosted integration, private session ledger, production-only UIDAI-issued Aadhaar metadata verification; test results cannot award Trust. Requires authorized provider activation and consenting live acceptance.
Durable Place IDs and source, fixed labels, private service-only 28-day coordinate receipts, DB-enforced create/update binding and hourly expired-coordinate purge. Names and addresses stay transient.

productionVisualAcceptance: Pending deployment and actual interaction. Locked Mac/native browser confirmation blocks current browser input; no screenshot substituted.
